glosses: in the distance, afar (at a great distance)

examples.en: I saw a light far away.

examples.text: Я не хочу быть вдали от дома.
examples.en: I don't want to be away from home.
I could hear sirens in the distance.
We saw a castle in the distance.

examples.text: Мы увидели вдали ещё один корабль.
examples.en: We saw another ship in the distance.
